title: Quality Compounding
hook: My best clients came from proud work. Never from good enough.
statement: Better work draws better opportunities, if people see it.
explainer: Great work nobody sees goes nowhere. Quality first, then get it seen.
sop: Score Visibility. Then show your best work.
equation_example: Quality 9 × Visibility 4 = 36. Great work, and almost nobody sees it.
question: Name one good enough thing that should be excellent.
closing_statement: Opportunity follows the standard, not the grind.
